reasons: You're 7-2 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 16%.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 3rd of 11 contenders (150.3 points a week).
Your weakest position is RB (5th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 3rd in 2026, 2nd in 2027 and 3rd in 2028 (title chances about 16%, 18%, 19%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.
We tested the best fair trade with 6 teams and none clearly raises your title chance beyond the simulation's margin (about 2 points).
Re-check before the deadline (4 weeks left): injuries change this quickly.
